generated_by: manual audit (see changelog Oct 18, 2026); applied by modules/chargen.py on top of races.json

start_table.note: Latest revision on Oct 18, 2026: no edits after rev 74855 (history: 72076 created Sep 16 ... 74855 Sep 29). All 144 race/class rows and every deity cell re-parsed and match this Codex's data exactly.

official.name: Official Early Access FAQ (playable races, starting areas)
official.finding: 9 playable races; 4 start locations; Underdocks is for 'some neutral and evil race/faith/class combinations'. No per-class list.

official.name: Official class pages (races per class)
official.finding: Race lists agree with the wiki table for every class except Enchanter, which also lists Human. Other extra races (High Elf, Troll, Var'nai, Deep Dwarf) are not playable in Early Access.

official.name: Patch notes 0.29-0.30.2.9
official.finding: No start-city changes since the table. Patch 46 added 'available location' to deity selection, so starts depend on deity (matches the table's per-deity cells).

official.name: Forum player posts (no dev or staff answers found)
official.finding: Players report: Paladins cannot start in the Underdocks; Goblins only get the Underdocks; a Deep Elf with Maelsin Thrys cannot pick the Underdocks but can with another god; a Deep Elf Monk starts in Ail'Vorith. All agree with the table.

conflicts.sources: Wiki start table rev 74855: no Human Enchanter row. Official Enchanter page, wiki Human page (Playable Classes) and wiki Enchanter page (rev 82930: Human starting stats 16/17/16/16/20/16/21 and bonus-point advice): Human can be an Enchanter.
conflicts.winner: Official + two wiki pages: Human Enchanter added. Start city Night Harbor (the Enchanter Starter Quest and its NPC Master Wincog are in Night Harbor, per wiki Night Harbor rev 83168 and Enchanter Starter Quest rev 80831; good/neutral races start there per the FAQ). Deities and an Underdocks option are not sourced.
conflicts.label: UNVERIFIED

conflicts.sources: Wiki Night Harbor (rev 83168, 2026-10-18) NPC table: Master Wincog (Gnome, Trainer, Wincog's Curious Goods) is the Enchanter guild master. Wiki Enchanter Starter Quest (Night Harbor) (rev 80831, 2026-10-12): your Torn Note goes to Master Wincog. Against: wiki Enchanter class page (rev 82930, 2026-10-18) says 'Master Khaila is the guild master and an enchanter scribe (spells) is next to her', and the wiki has a Master Khaila page (rev 40628, 2026-06-15: Human Enchanter, 'Enchanter guild master', Night Harbor, north of the Twilight Harbor area).
conflicts.winner: Master Wincog for the start: the newer city page and the starter quest agree. Khaila's page is older (June) and the class-page sentence may predate the starter quest, but neither has been removed, so Master Khaila may still be an Enchanter trainer and the spell scribe stands next to her. Not resolved in game.
conflicts.label: UNVERIFIED

conflicts.sources: Start table and official Fighter page and wiki Halfling page: yes. Wiki Fighter creation table: no Halfling row.
conflicts.winner: Start table (kept). The creation table is just incomplete.
conflicts.label: FACT

conflicts.combo: Gnome and Human in the Underdocks
conflicts.sources: Wiki Gnome and Human race pages (last edited Mar-May, 'during development'): Night Harbor only. Start table: Underdocks for some classes.

conflicts.combo: Deep Elf Inquisitor / Monk / Paladin / Spellblade in the Underdocks
conflicts.sources: Start table: not available. Deep Elf race page lists the Underdocks as a Deep Elf start (race-level, not per class). No Underdocks starter quest exists on the wiki for these four classes; the Monk page lists only Night Harbor and Ail'Vorith class quests; forum players confirm no Paladin Underdocks start.
conflicts.winner: Start table (unchanged): these four classes start only in Ail'Vorith as a Deep Elf.
conflicts.label: FACT
